svg.text: Latimer Core Data Package — table relationships
25 entity tables (primary key) and 81 junction tables (two foreign keys, no primary key). Each junction table hangs beneath the entity that owns it (grey tree);
its second foreign key runs to the coloured trunk of the table it references. Lines of one colour join (●) a trunk that enters the referenced table. Loops are self references.
Source: ltc-dp/table-schemas (foreign keys). Generated by src/build-erd.py.
